# NVIDIA encoder API header

`nvEncodeAPI.h` is unmodified from FFmpeg/nv-codec-headers tag n13.0.19.1,
commit `88fee5c37318c991a8762d423530f91681e32e3a`:
https://github.com/FFmpeg/nv-codec-headers/blob/88fee5c37318c991a8762d423530f91681e32e3a/include/ffnvcodec/nvEncodeAPI.h

Copyright NVIDIA Corporation; the permissive license is retained at the top of
the header. This supplies declarations only. The encoder DLL comes from the
installed NVIDIA display driver and is not bundled here. It grants no rights
to Unreal Tournament code or assets.
